_comment: OTA-tunable gaze numbers. Whitelisted and CLAMPED by app/gaze/src/tuning.mjs -- unknown keys are refused, out-of-range values are pulled to the nearest edge, and every range in that file is a protection decision with its reason written beside it. Numbers only: executable code stays in the binary, same store-policy split as scriptlets. Run scripts/gen-rules-manifest.mjs after editing or shipped apps never see the change.
